title: Center Stage Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: If you want to be at the center of it all, then no look further than this sophisticated Seaside, Florida, town center apartment aptly dubbed "Center Stage." The Seaside Amphitheater, restaurants, shops, and of course the Gulf are all located within a stone's throw of this professionally decorated 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment that can sleep up to 12 people.
description_expanded: Description63 CENTRAL SQUARE2 KINGS, BUNKROOM WITH 6 TWINS Center Stage | Luxury Living Above the Seaside AmphitheaterWelcome to Center Stage, a beautifully renovated luxury vacation rental located above the iconic Seaside Amphitheater. Positioned in the very heart of Seaside, Florida, this elevated retreat offers front-row views of town life, glowing sunsets over Seaside’s rooftops, and distant Gulf views—all just 400 feet from the sugar-white sands of Seaside’s private beach.Perfect for families or groups, Center Stage blends upscale coastal design with an unbeatable walk-everywhere location, placing you steps from Seaside’s shops, dining, events, and the beach.Expansive Porch with Amphitheater & Sunset ViewsStep outside to the spacious open-air front porch, where palm trees sway below and the Amphitheater becomes your backdrop. Enjoy morning coffee at sunrise or dine al fresco at the bistro table for six, accompanied by Gulf breezes and the occasional sounds of live music drifting up from below.This elevated vantage point makes Center Stage a prime viewing spot for Fourth of July and New Year’s Eve fireworks, as well as nightly sunsets that wash Seaside in golden light with glimpses of the Gulf beyond.Stylish Living Spaces Designed for ComfortInside, the home features a thoughtfully renovated interior with elegant coastal décor and designer furnishings throughout. The living room invites relaxation with a plush cloud-style sectional, two cozy club chairs, and a large mounted plasma TV—perfect for winding down after a beach day.Adjacent, the dining area comfortably seats eight beneath a striking pendant light, creating a warm, welcoming space for shared meals and conversation.Chef’s Kitchen with Premium FinishesThe fully equipped chef’s kitchen is both functional and beautiful, featuring a quartz center island, stainless steel appliances, abundant custom cabinetry, and bar seating for four. Whether preparing a casual breakfast or a gourmet dinner, this kitchen is stocked and designed to support elevated coastal living.Private King Suites & Bonus Bunk RoomDown the hallway, the primary king suite offers a peaceful retreat with luxury linens, built-in shelving, reading lights, two lounge chairs, and generous storage. The spa-inspired ensuite bath features dual quartz vanities, a large LED mirror, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.The second king bedroom includes blackout shades, a large dresser, mounted plasma TV, and access to a beautifully updated hall bathroom with a tub/shower combination.Between the two suites is a custom-built bunk room with six twin beds—ideal for children or group stays. This thoughtfully designed space includes built-in cabinetry and nautical hooks, and is open to the hallway with partial separation (no full wall or door).Additional Conveniences for a Seamless StayGuests will also enjoy a full-size stackable washer and dryer tucked into a hallway laundry closet, making longer stays easy and comfortable.An Unmatched Seaside LocationWith its elevated views, refined renovation, and front-and-center location above the Seaside Amphitheater, Center Stage offers a truly unforgettable Seaside experience. Walk everywhere, soak in the energy of town, and return home each evening to sunset views and effortless luxury.Center Stage is ideal for guests who want to be at the center of it all—without sacrificing comfort, style, or space.* 5 night minimum Summer, Spring, & Spring Bk, 3-night minimum Fall, 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,904 square feet of beautifully renovated living spaceSeaside Beach Access at Coleman PavilionRecently renovated with designer furnishings throughoutPremier Peacock Alley Linen Partner, featuring fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley shams, coverlets, sheets, and towelsGray Malin artwork is showcased throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote provided, including 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued. Center Stage relies on available parking along Quincy Circle and is approved to receive two parking passes. A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
